main_measure.name: mean excess 5-bar return after forecast < 0 (non-overlapping grid)
main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean < 0 with t <= -2 over >= 30 cases and rank correlation < 0; reject: mean > 0 with t >= +2 over >= 30 cases

supporting_check.name: Spearman rank correlation of |forecast| with excess 5-bar return, below 0

decided_by: Only 18 cases, all coins and windows pooled, fewer than the plan's minimum of 30.
reading: Situation bars are bars with the recorded raw fail_depth value above 0 (recomputed from prices only where missing); grid bars whose 5-bar forward return would leave the window are dropped both from the cases and from the coin's mean, and an undefined rank correlation counts as a failed check.
